changelog: Added AeroFoil cheat manager support in Remote.
Download, install, view, create, edit, delete, and upload cheats.
Remote titles are now grouped by base game, update, and DLC.
Redesigned the remote editor with a themed modal interface.
Improved compatibility with legacy remotes, including custom headers and nested directory indexes.
Remote lists and legacy title loading are more robust.
Shut down cleanly when exiting the app from HB launcher
Improved HTTP range-download failures with meaningful diagnostics instead of generic errors.
Added timeouts and retry handling to avoid stalled network installs.
Fixed remote authentication handling so credentials are only sent to the configured server origin.
Fixed UAUTH generation when a server uses its default port.
